readme.run: Compute 2D or 3D structure-tensor orientation, coherency and energy maps
notes: Input is a TIFF, OME-TIFF, NIfTI (.nii, .nii.gz), PNG, JPEG, or a sequence of 2D slices.
Outputs orientation/azimuth/elevation, coherency, energy, HSB/RGB direction maps, vectors and CSV.
No network connection is required and no external models are downloaded.
Please cite Rezakhaniha et al. 2012 (OrientationJ) and Püspöki et al. 2016.
